nodes.text: ❖ Two HMPV Cases in Karnataka: On 6th January, 2025, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) confirmed two Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in Karnataka, with no significant increase in respiratory illnesses nationwide, as surveillance continues.
